description:
Create a Sentry uptime monitor that checks a URL over HTTP on an interval. Response assertions are not supported; set them in the Sentry UI.
Scheduled jobs (cron): find_monitors. Metric thresholds: find_metric_monitors.

body.description: Request body, for methods that take one.

downtimeThreshold.description: Consecutive failed checks required to mark down.

environment.description: Environment for uptime issues this monitor creates.

headers.description: HTTP headers as [name, value] pairs, e.g. [["Accept","application/json"]].

method.description: HTTP method used for the uptime check request.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

recoveryThreshold.description: Consecutive successful checks required to recover.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

responseCaptureEnabled.description: Capture response body and headers on failed checks.

status.description: Monitor status. `disabled` stops checks and does not count against quota.

traceSampling.description: Whether check requests may be considered for tracing.

name: create_uptime_monitor
title: Create Uptime Monitor
